<head-word>תָּיו</head-word>

<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> תָּוָה)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>mark</italic>; </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>2)</number>
<definition> תי"ו 
<italic>the letter Tav</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 55
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Ez. IX, 4) לך ורשום … ת' של דיו go and make on the foreheads of the righteous a mark (Tav) with ink; ועל … ת' של דם and on the foreheads of the wicked a mark (Tav) with blood. Ib. אלו … מאלף עד ת' those are the men that fulfilled the Law from Alef to Tav. Ib. ומאי שנא ת' and why a Tav? Ib. ת' סוף חותמו של הקב"ה the Tav is the last letter in God’s seal (אמת). Ib. 104
<sup>a</sup> תי"ו אמת Tav intimates 
<italic>truth</italic>; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="V00424">
<head-word>תְּיוּבָא</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> m, תְּיוּבְתָּא
<pos> f.</pos> (תּוּב) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> = תּוּבָא, 
<italic>vomit</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Prov. XXVI, 11 תְּיוּבֵיה (Ms. תיובת').</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>return</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Job XXIV, 23 (ed. Lag. תִּיבוּתָא).—Esp. = h. תְּשׁוּבָה 
<italic>return to God, repentance</italic>. Targ. Jer. XXXIII, 6 (ed. Wil. תִּיוּבָא). Targ. Cant. V, 5; a. fr.—Taan. 23
<sup>b</sup> אנא בעי … דליהדרו בת' I prayed that they might die, but she prayed that they might return in repentance (Ber. 10
<sup>a</sup> דלהדרו בתשובה); a. e.—V. תְּתוּבָא.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>answer, reply, refutation, argument</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Jer. XII, 5. Targ. Job XXXII, 3; 5; a. e.—B. Mets. 16
<sup>a</sup>
<pgbrk id="pg1664" /> הא גברא והא ת' here is the man, and here is his answer (such an ingenious answer only such a man can give); גברא קא חזינא ות' וכ' I see the man, but I do not see the answer (his argument does not convince me). Ab. Zar. 68
<sup>a</sup> חגא … ת' קא מותיב Ḥagga knows not what the Rabbis say, and dares to argue? Ber. 10
<sup>b</sup> ת' דרב חסדא ת' this is an argument against Rab Ḥisda; it is an argument (R. Ḥ. stands refuted). Ib. 21
<sup>a</sup> ת' this is a final refutation; a. v. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. תְּיוּבָתָא</plural-form>. Targ. Job XXI, 34 Ms. (ed. 
<italic>sing</italic>.).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>pl.</italic> as ab.</definition>
<notes>
<italic>going to and fro, waywardness</italic>. Targ. Jer. V, 6 (ed. Wil. תִּיוּ'). Ib. XIV, 7 תְּיוּבָתָנָא (not תְּיוּבְתָּ'); a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="V00431">
<head-word>תִּיחוּחַ</head-word>
<head-word>תִּח'</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (תחח, transp.</definition>
<notes> of חת; cmp. תותח, Job XLI, 21, = תחתח) 
<italic>crushing</italic>; עֲפַר ת' 
<italic>crushed, loose earth</italic>. Ohol. XVIII, 8 ועפר התי' (Mish. ed. והעפר, corr. acc., or והעָפָר התָּחוּחַ; Maim. comment. ed. Dehr. עֲפַר תּוֹחָח). Tosef. ib. XVI, 5 ואיזו היא בתולח … רושם ואין עפרח תי' ed. Zuck. (Var. ואין עפר תחתיו) virgin soil is that in which there is no imprint, and the earth of which is not 
<italic>ʿăfar ti</italic>
<italic>ḥuaḥ</italic>; Nidd. 8
<sup>b</sup>, v. רְשָׁשִׁין. Bets. 8
<sup>a</sup> top עפר תח' (Tosaf. תיח'). Sabb. 39
<sup>a</sup>. Ber. 40
<sup>a</sup> (Ms. F. תוחח, v. supra). Y. B. Bath. II, beg. 13
<sup>b</sup> מפני שעושין עפר תח' וכ' because they (the rocks or boulders near a wall) make the ground around them loose, and affect the earth of the wall; Bab. ib. 19
<sup>b</sup> שמחלידין … ומעלין עפר תי' they (the roots of trees near a wall) undermine the ground, and generate loose earth; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

V, 2 ומתקנין שם ת' גדול and they introduced a great improvement there; ib. מאי ת' גדול וכ' what was that great improvement? … The woman’s compartment was open, and they put a railing around it &c. <sup>b</sup> תִּקָּן וכ'. Pesik. shimʿu, p. 118
<sup>a</sup> על שם שלא … כתִיקּוּנָהּ בא"י because I did not separate one Ḥallah in Palestine as was proper; Cant. R. to I, 6 כתִקָּנָהּ; ib. על שלא … כתִקּוּנוֹ וכ' because I did not keep one Holy Day in Palestine as I ought to have &c. Pesik. R. s. 28 שאין עושים … כתִיקָּנָם וכ' my children do not observe the festivals according to their institution, as they were commanded &c. Meg. 2
<sup>a</sup> בזמן שהשנים כתִיקָּנָן וכ' when the seasons of the year were as they ought to be (when the calendar was regulated by the court), and Israel dwelt in their land; a. fr.—ת' סופרים the emendations of Biblical phrases introduced by the Sof’rim (v. סוֹפֵר) to obviate apparently irreverent expressions. Tanḥ. B’shall. 16 [where the text is largely interpolated]. Gen. R. s. 49 (ref. to Gen. XVIII, 22) ת' ס' הוא זה שהשכינה וכ' this is a Soferic emendation (for, ‘and the Lord stood yet before Abraham’), for the Shechinah waited for Abraham; Midr. Till. to Ps. XVIII; (Lev. R. s. 11 תַּקָּנַת ס'); a. fr.—[A list of these emendations is to be found in Tanḥ. l. c.; Sifré Num. 84; Mekh. B’shall., Shir., s. 6; Yalk. Ex. 247; v. esp. Frensdorff, Ochlah W’ochlah, p. 113.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>
